title: Ledumahadi mafube – Pacaraima Peak
text:
135 Words Ledumahadi mafube
End of quarter, decent fund rebalancing on tape, with good sector rotation — largest inflows into telecom, healthcare, energy and financials. Outflows in technology, industrials and small caps. Europe still unloved with continuing outflows now since 29 weeks — SPX hasn’t revisited it’s 50d moving average in 3 months now, hinting at another year-end rally. NY is packed with tourists, 5th ave. AAPL store has queues outside, meatpacking TSLA flagship is buzzing.. The 3 months leading to holiday season seem all glitter. Oh yeah.
In the meantime Musk is about to be kicked out of his own company for a tweet that moved the stock price by ‘massive’ 6%. Hmm, that’s about the usual daily move we’ve seen on this name the past 6months. Reminds me of Steve Jobs being kicked out of AAPL. We know the story.
